title: Resolution urging Albany to define "consent" in penal law
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature to pass, and the Governor to sign, S.5521/A.1140, which would add a formal legal definition of consent to the Penal Law. The bills define consent as a freely given, knowledgeable and informed agreement by a person with the capacity to reason. Supporters say this would help clarify cases involving sexual assault, domestic violence, trafficking and other offenses where consent is central.
